summary:
Project Blast Off is a game project where you plan, travel to and discover celestial bodies! Prepare your ship and ready for blast off!

Aimed at young adults aged 13–18, the game follows an ordinary person who suddenly awakens aboard a spacecraft with no recollection of how they got there. Accompanied by an unusual moon-dwelling alien named Mooner (Walpurgisnacht), players must navigate their unfamiliar surroundings, rediscover their abilities and learn the fundamentals of spaceflight. Through humorous dialogue, interactive tutorials and guided gameplay, players gradually uncover the mechanics of spacecraft navigation, including gravitational slingshots and delta-v (expected change in velocity), as they embark on an unexpected journey among the stars.
details:
Project Blast Off is an interactive space planner game that helps young adults to navigate and improve their knowledge on spaceflight. It starts off with a spacecraft on the way to the moon and you and your alien friend named Mooner (Walpurgisnacht) are trying to find a solution.

This helps with beginners to be more competent about the design and plan of extraterrestrial travel by starting the missions with relative "handholding" until they are experienced enough to slowly let them decide their own budgeting, research and other important design and plan choices.

This project was made to educate the people that wish to further polish their knowledge in spaceflight simulation. The project teaches the users the fundamentals of spacecraft design, spacecraft communication, orbital mechanics and delta-v budgeting all a part of space mission designing and planning.

Our project was mainly inspired by the Kerbal Space Program. Our objective is to be stripped to be only the fundamentals of spaceflight planning.

We had considered many factors like realistic space travel, slingshot maneuver, gamification of complex mathematics, etc

This project was made entirely with Godot and Aseprite
